content.text:
Perfect! Added `renderInvoiceText()` with 11 comprehensive tests.

**New file src/render.js:**
- `renderInvoiceText(invoice)` — renders invoice as plain text
  - Returns ok(text) or fail(error)
  - First line: invoice number (or "DRAFT" if unpublished)
  - Second line: customer name
  - One line per item: `qty x name @ price = total`
  - Final line: `Total: amount`
  - All amounts formatted with `formatEuros()`

**Format example:**
```
INV-2026-0001
Northwind Studio
5x Development (hour) @ €95.00 = €475.00
1x Logo package @ €1,200.00 = €1,200.00
Total: €1,675.00
```

**Tests cover:**
- ✓ Draft and issued invoices
- ✓ Multiple line items
- ✓ Large amounts with thousands separators
- ✓ Correct total calculation
- ✓ Customer lookup (CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND)
- ✓ Invalid invoice (null, missing customerId)
- ✓ Different customers
- ✓ Integration with issueInvoice

All 73 tests pass.
